mapper.select: SELECT id, stat_date AS statDate, complaint_time AS complaintTime, dept_code AS deptCode, dept_name AS deptName, person_name AS personName, position, category, result, remark FROM TR_SVC_QUALITY_CMPL WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY complaint_time DESC

SELECT id, stat_date AS statDate, praise_time AS praiseTime, dept_code AS deptCode, dept_name AS deptName, person_name AS personName, position, method, feedback, remark FROM TR_SVC_QUALITY_PRZ WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY praise_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_SVC_QUALITY_CMPL (id, stat_date, complaint_time, dept_code, dept_name, person_name, position, category, result, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (seq_tr_reports.NEXTVAL, NVL(#{statDate}, SYSDATE), #{complaintTime}, #{deptCode}, #{deptName}, #{personName}, #{position}, #{category}, #{result}, #{remark}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_SVC_QUALITY_CMPL SET complaint_time = #{complaintTime}, stat_date = NVL(#{statDate}, TRUNC(#{complaintTime})), dept_code = #{deptCode}, dept_name = #{deptName}, person_name = #{personName}, position = #{position}, category = #{category}, result = #{result}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_SVC_QUALITY_PRZ (id, stat_date, praise_time, dept_code, dept_name, person_name, position, method, feedback, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (seq_tr_reports.NEXTVAL, NVL(#{statDate}, SYSDATE), #{praiseTime}, #{deptCode}, #{deptName}, #{personName}, #{position}, #{method}, #{feedback}, #{remark}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_SVC_QUALITY_PRZ SET praise_time = #{praiseTime}, stat_date = NVL(#{statDate}, TRUNC(#{praiseTime})), dept_code = #{deptCode}, dept_name = #{deptName}, person_name = #{personName}, position = #{position}, method = #{method}, feedback = #{feedback}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{id}
